description: This line plot illustrates the accuracy of Llama3.3 on the PopQA dataset as a function of the s_pop frequency, with the o_pop parameter implicitly held constant as per the caption. The x-axis represents the s_pop frequency on a linear scale, labeled “s_pop frequency (x10^4)”, ranging from 1 to 19 with tick marks at every integer interval. The y-axis represents accuracy on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. Two distinct data series are plotted: a blue dashed line with circular markers and a green solid line with square markers. The blue line begins at approximately 0.72 accuracy at s_pop frequency 1, rises to a peak of about 0.99 at s_pop frequency 9, and then remains nearly constant at 1.0 from s_pop frequency 11 to 19. The green line begins at approximately 0.37 accuracy at s_pop frequency 1, rises to a peak of about 0.70 at s_pop frequency 7, then declines to approximately 0.48 at s_pop frequency 13, and subsequently rises again to approximately 0.99 at s_pop frequency 17 before stabilizing at 1.0 from s_pop frequency 19. Both lines exhibit error bars indicating variability in the measurements.
